## English

### New Features

- Add live screen mirroring and device control with mouse clicks, dragging, scrolling, keyboard input, and text paste in portrait or landscape.
- Add PNG screenshots, MP4 recording, and quality controls. Mirroring and recording are video-only; recordings are saved when the screen orientation or size changes.
- Add Back, Home, Recents, volume, and lock/wake controls, with target-device confirmation before restarting or shutting down.

### Improvements

- Refine the mirroring area with a subtle grid and screen shadow to match the light workspace.

## 简体中文

### 新功能

- 新增实时投屏与设备控制，支持鼠标点击、拖动、滚动、键盘输入和文本粘贴，适配横竖屏。
- 支持 PNG 截图、MP4 录像与清晰度切换。投屏和录像不含音频；画面方向或尺寸变化时自动结束并保存录像。
- 支持返回、主页、最近任务、音量与锁屏/唤醒操作，重启或关机前确认目标设备。

### 改进

- 投屏区域采用细网格与轻微画面阴影，与浅色工作台保持一致。
